Авторы провели комплексную оценку передовых LLM, включая последние модели «с ризонингом» (такие как o1/o3 от OpenAI и Gemini Pro от Google), на новом наборе простых бенчмарков для проверки логических способностей. Эти бенчмарки состоят из (1) процедурно-генерируемых задач (например, счёт, логика, планирование) с настраиваемой «утомительностью», позволяющей масштабировать вычислительную нагрузку без изменения основной сложности — похоже на недавнюю статью Apple (https://t.me/gonzo_ML_podcasts/234), и (2) датасета UNPUZZLES, который содержит известные логические головоломки вместе с их вручную

clusters.name: LLM Machine Translation Eval
clusters.distinguishing: Assesses LLMs as MT systems against specialized engines across domains, considering quality, cost-effectiveness, and generalization. This is narrower than general LLM benchmarks and distinct from cognitive or welfare metrics by focusing on translation performance.

papers.title: Выпустили новый пост про GPT as MT, теперь про ChatGPT.
papers.one_liner: Evaluates ChatGPT as a machine translation system, showing competitive quality at a fraction of vendor costs.
papers.summary: TL;DR GPT дизраптит машинный перевод, 10x дешевле обычных вендоров, и порой не хуже. А ещё всякие доп.возможности...

papers.title: И на этот раз GPT показала вообще лучший результат для пары en-es, и второй лучший для en-de на general domain. На специальных доменах похуже, но всё равно лучше некоторых движков. Там, конечно, ещё требуется человеческую оценку провести, посмотреть на типы ошибок и оценить, как это влияет на те бизнес-процессы, где её будут использовать, но начало многообещающее.
papers.one_liner: Evaluates GPT-4 translation quality versus specialized MT systems across domains, showing state-of-the-art general-domain performance and competitive domain-specific results.
papers.summary: А вот это вот интересная история. Мы померяли качество перевода с помощью GPT-4 (как недавно делали это для ChatGPT, а ранее для GPT-3).

clusters.name: Neural Decoding Evaluation
clusters.distinguishing: Evaluates decoding of brain signals (MEG) related to language production, scrutinizing alignment, motor confounds, and filtering artifacts. Unlike LLM or task benchmarks, it targets neuroimaging methodology and validity of representational claims.

papers.title: Правда, на этом графике они типа утверждают, что якобы декодируют сугубо лингвистические репрезентации, но тут надо разбираться, насколько хорошо они могли их отделить от простой подготовки движений (перед любым произвольным движением возникает так называемый премоторный потенциал и соответствующие вариации в магнитных полях). Эти паттерны во времени организованы в строгом соответствии с письменным текстом, так что создаются все условия для декодирования.
papers.one_liner: MEG-based decoding of hierarchical neural dynamics during typed language production, probing linguistic vs motor representations and impacted by FIR filter leakage concerns.
papers.summary: Тут люди даже не смотрят картинки или слушают речь, как в предыдущих работах того же Жана-Реми Кинга, а печатают на клавиатуре. Кроме подготовительной премоторной активности, каждое движение стимулирует рецепторы в мышцах и суставах, а момент нажатия на клавишу даёт особенно чёткую стимуляцию кожи, и в коре возникают очень чёткие паттерны.

clusters.name: AGI Psychometric Batteries
clusters.distinguishing: Applies CHC-grounded psychometric test design to quantify multi-domain cognitive abilities of AI systems, yielding structured AGI scores and profiles. This contrasts with task or domain-specific evaluations by using formal cognitive theory and standardized batteries.

papers.title: https://www.agidefinition.ai/
papers.one_liner: Defines AGI via CHC-grounded psychometrics across ten cognitive domains, yielding quantitative AGI scores and exposing memory-centric deficits in current models.
papers.summary: The lack of a concrete definition for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) obscures the gap between today’s specialized AI and human-level cognition. This paper introduces a quantifiable framework to address this, defining AGI as matching the cognitive versatility and proficiency of a well-educated adult. To operationalize this, we ground our methodology in Cattell-Horn-Carroll theory, the most empirically validated model of human cognition.

clusters.name: Welfare-Oriented Eval Metrics
clusters.distinguishing: Proposes a policy-facing evaluation metric (PAR) that trades off prediction accuracy against access to screening, optimizing aid for the worst-off. Unlike technical performance metrics or capability benchmarks, it embeds welfare economics and decision rules into evaluation.

papers.title: The Value of Prediction in Identifying the Worst-Off
papers.one_liner: Introduces PAR, a welfare-based metric comparing investment in prediction accuracy versus expanding screening access for aiding the worst-off.
papers.summary: Что сделано? В этой статье авторы вводят формальный фреймворк для оценки компромисса между улучшением точности прогнозов модели и расширением бюрократических возможностей (т.е. охватом большего числа людей) в государственных программах, нацеленных на помощь «наиболее уязвимым» слоям населения. Авторы разрабатывают коэффициент «предсказание-доступ» (Prediction-Access Ratio, PAR) — новую метрику, которая количественно определяет относительную пользу для общественного благосостояния от инвестиций в более точные прогнозы по сравнению с увеличением числа людей, которых можно проверить и поддержать.

families.name: Robotics / VLA models
families.curated_description: Robot policies and vision-language-action models: RT-X / OpenVLA style policies, dexterous manipulation, ALOHA-like imitation learning, action-tokenized transformers, and embodied agents.
families.distinguishing: Robotics / VLA models center on policies that map visual observations and natural-language commands directly to low-level robot actions or action tokens, and are evaluated on real or simulated manipulation and control. Unlike generic VLMs or omni-multimodal models, these works add embodiment-specific interfaces (grippers, end-effector poses, trajectories) and training from demonstrations or RL on robot datasets (e.g., RT-X/ALOHA) to produce executable control. They differ from agent/tool-use papers by operating the physical control loop themselves, and from diffusion/AR generative families by optimizing for closed-loop action fidelity and latency rather than content generation.

clusters.name: Foundation-LM Embodied VLMs
clusters.distinguishing: These works adapt large foundation LLM/VLMs into embodied policies by injecting visual/action tokens and leveraging prompting or fine-tuning for high-level command emission. They focus on multimodal grounding of powerful general models (PaLM/Gemini) rather than compact architectures or hierarchical orchestration. Unlike RL-scaling or small-footprint VLAs, the emphasis is on leveraging pre-trained language reasoning to control agents.

papers.title: Danny Driess, Fei Xia, Mehdi S. M. Sajjadi, Corey Lynch, Aakanksha Chowdhery, Brian Ichter, Ayzaan Wahid, Jonathan Tompson, Quan Vuong, Tianhe Yu, Wenlong Huang, Yevgen Chebotar, Pierre Sermanet, Daniel Duckworth, Sergey Levine, Vincent Vanhoucke, Karol Hausman, Marc Toussaint, Klaus Greff, Andy Zeng, Igor Mordatch, Pete Florence
papers.one_liner: Scales PaLM with visual and sensor-action tokens to create an embodied multimodal language model that outputs high-level robot commands.
papers.summary: В итоге самая крупная модель PaLM-E на 562B параметров, на данный момент самая большая картиночно-языковая модель. Дофига для dense модели, конечно. Это GPT-подобная декодерная модель, генерирующая выходные токены авторегрессионно.

papers.title: SIMA 2: A Generalist Embodied Agent for Virtual Worlds
papers.one_liner: SIMA 2 fine-tunes Gemini into a CoT-enabled VLA agent, emitting action tokens for complex tasks and self-improving via LLM-generated tasks and rewards in diverse virtual worlds.
papers.summary: Представили SIMA 2 — универсальную Vision-Language-Action (VLA) модель, созданную через файнтюнинг Gemini Flash-Lite. В отличие от первой версии (https://t.me/gonzo_ML/2466), которая просто переводила инструкции в нажатия клавиш, SIMA 2 интегрирует внутренний процесс рассуждения (chain-of-thought). Это позволяет ей справляться с неоднозначными инструкциями, вести диалог и выполнять сложные многошаговые задачи в различных 3D-средах.

clusters.name: Compact Efficient VLA Control
clusters.distinguishing: Papers here build small, deployable VLA models (≈450M params) with specialized action heads and efficient inference that match or surpass larger models using modest data. They target practical robot control and parameter efficiency, distinct from foundation-model-based policies or hierarchical planner–executor systems. The focus is on model/design efficiency rather than orchestration or RL.

papers.title: SmolVLA: A vision-language-action model for affordable and efficient robotics
papers.one_liner: SmolVLA delivers a 450M-parameter VLA with flow-matched action head and async inference, matching larger models using <30k public episodes.
papers.summary: ? Авторы представляют SmolVLA — компактную модель «зрение-язык-действие» (Vision-Language-Action, VLA) с ~450 млн параметров, разработанную с упором на эффективность и доступность. Подход состоит из трёх элементов: 1) Облегчённая архитектура, использующая компактную основу VLM со стратегическим пропуском слоёв и эффективного «эксперта по действиям» с чередующимся вниманием и flow matching. 2) Предобучение исключительно на небольшом, тщательно отобранном наборе публичных датасетов от сообщества (менее 30 тыс. эпизодов). 3) Новый асинхронный стек для инференса, который отделяет выполнение действ

papers.title: https://t.me/gonzo_ML_podcasts/255
papers.one_liner: SmolVLA: a 450M-parameter VLA model that outperforms larger peers for robot control, enabling deployment on diverse hardware.
papers.summary: Классная движуха про демократизацию моделей «зрение-язык-действие» (Vision-Language-Action, VLA). Авторы обучили SmolVLA — компактную модель для управления роботом. Модель в 10 раз меньше конкурентов, всего 450M параметров, при этом как правило лучше. С таким размером можно влезть на очень разное железо. И это ещё без квантования.

clusters.name: Hierarchical Planner–Executor VLAs
clusters.distinguishing: These systems use an explicit split between high-level embodied reasoning/planning and a lower-level VLA controller or executor, often enabling multi-embodiment transfer and zero-shot skills. They differ from monolithic VLAs by introducing an orchestration layer or two-agent setup that plans before acting. Unlike RL training, control emerges from hierarchical coordination.

papers.title: Gemini Robotics 1.5: Pushing the Frontier of Generalist Robots with Advanced Embodied Reasoning, Thinking, and Motion Transfer
papers.one_liner: Gemini Robotics 1.5 couples an ER orchestrator with a VLA controller, adding motion transfer and embodied thinking for zero-shot multi-embodiment robotic skills.
papers.summary: ? В статье представлено семейство Gemini Robotics 1.5 — пара фундаментальных моделей, предназначенных для развития робототехники общего назначения. Семейство включает: 1) Gemini Robotics 1.5 (GR 1.5) — модель «зрение-язык-действие» (VLA) для низкоуровневого управления, работающую с разными физическими воплощениями (multi-embodiment), и 2) Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 (GR-ER 1.5) — SOTA-модель для воплощённых рассуждений (Embodied Reasoning, ER) для высокоуровневого понимания и планирования. Работа предлагает три ключевых нововведения. Во-первых, новый механизм переноса движений (Motion Transfer, MT)

papers.title: https://t.me/gonzo_ML_podcasts/946
papers.one_liner: Gemini Robotics 1.5 uses a Gemini 2.5-based planner-executor duo to plan and execute vision-conditioned actions on physical robots.
papers.summary: Интересно, что параллельно с LLM/VLM Google продолжает совершенствовать модели для роботов, свежая — Gemini Robotics 1.5. Построена на Gemini 2.5, использует две модели/агента: первая планирует, вторая выполняет действия на физическом роботе. Так и роботов скоро начнут продавать.

clusters.name: RL-Scaled VLM Agents
clusters.distinguishing: This cluster focuses on reinforcement learning to extend VLM decision-making to long horizons using techniques like asymmetric actor–critic, lightweight critics, and advantage filtering. Unlike imitation-driven or planner–executor VLAs, the core contribution is an RL training recipe that scales step count and stability for visual agents.

papers.title: Odysseus: Scaling VLMs to 100+ Turn Decision-Making in Games via Reinforcement Learning
papers.one_liner: Odysseus trains VLM agents for 100+ step visual decision-making via an asymmetric actor-critic with a tiny CNN critic and positive-advantage filtering.
papers.summary: Авторы представили Odysseus — открытый фреймворк обучения с подкреплением (RL), который позволяет масштабировать Vision-Language Models (VLM) на задачи непрерывного принятия решений длиной более 100 шагов взаимодействия. Спарив огромную VLM-политику с крошечным CNN-критиком и применив фильтрацию положительных преимуществ (positive-advantage filtering), исследователи обходят вычислительные боттлнеки и нестабильность традиционных мультимодальных actor-critic методов.

clusters.name: Robotics Simulation Infrastructure
clusters.distinguishing: This category covers the physics engine and simulation tools that support training and evaluating robotic agents, not a VLA policy itself. It is distinct from all control-policy clusters by addressing the underlying simulator/physics environment rather than model architecture or training methodology.

papers.title: В Linux Foundation был передан проект Newton, опенсорс физический движок для симуляций при обучении роботов:
papers.one_liner: Newton is an open-source physics engine for robot training simulations, transferred to Linux Foundation stewardship.
papers.summary: Изначально совместный проект Disney Research, Google DeepMind и NVIDIA. Замена задепрекейченного NVIDIA Warp.

families.name: RAG, retrievers & embeddings
families.curated_description: Retrieval-augmented generation, embedding models (E5, BGE, GTE, NV-Embed), late-interaction retrievers (ColBERT), long-document retrieval, and retrieval evaluation.
families.distinguishing: This family centers on retrieval-augmented generation and the representation learning that powers it: training bi/late-interaction encoders, constructing vector indexes, and evaluating retrieval quality for grounding LMs. Unlike reasoning or agent families, the core innovation is selecting and ranking external documents via learned embeddings (e.g., E5/BGE/GTE, ColBERT) and integrating them into the prompt or model, not planning or tool use. It differs from LLM pretraining or multimodal models by optimizing utility-driven text retrieval pipelines and embedding robustness (including multilingual and variable-dimension) rather than broad generative capability. It is also distinct from long-context or KV-efficiency work: instead of scaling attention windows, it fetches targeted evidence and measures end-to-end RAG gains through retriever and reranker design.

clusters.name: Multilingual Bi-Encoders
clusters.distinguishing: Focuses on dual-encoder sentence embeddings trained with large-scale multilingual objectives and margin-based losses. Distinct from RAG orchestration or differentiable retrieval because it targets language-agnostic representation quality rather than retrieval pipelines or end-to-end training.

papers.title: Language-agnostic BERT Sentence Embedding
papers.one_liner: LaBSE builds multilingual sentence embeddings via a dual-encoder with additive-margin softmax and TLM+MLM pretraining, outperforming prior models across many low-resource languages.
papers.summary: В двух словах: LaBSE — более качественная замена multilingual BERT для эмбеддингов предложений. От Гугла.

clusters.name: Variable-Dimension Embeddings
clusters.distinguishing: Centers on Matryoshka-style embeddings that permit dimension truncation with graceful performance trade-offs. Unlike multilingual encoders, the emphasis is on deployment flexibility and vector-size control; unlike RAG methods, it does not orchestrate or learn retrieval but supplies adaptable embeddings.

papers.title: OpenAI натренировал свои новые эмбеддинговые модели с поддержкой этого дела (https://openai.com/blog/new-embedding-models-and-api-updates#ref-A), и теперь при запросе в апишке через параметр dimensions можно указывать, какого размера эмбеддинг вам нужен (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/embeddings/create#embeddings-create-dimensions).
papers.one_liner: OpenAI embeddings support Matryoshka-style dimension truncation, enabling variable-size vectors with graceful quality trade-offs via an API dimensions parameter.
papers.summary: Так, модель text-embedding-3-large, генерящую эмбеддинг размера 3072, можно попросить его урезать до размера, подходящего вашей векторной базе данных. При этом отрежутся менее значимые данные и качество будет даже выше, чем у модели предыдущего поколения с эмбеддингом меньшего размера.

clusters.name: Hierarchical Memory RAG
clusters.distinguishing: Builds a query-agnostic, hierarchical memory tree of summaries and navigates it interactively with CoT prompts to surpass context limits. This differs from differentiable RAG, which optimizes retrieval end-to-end; here the novelty is zero-shot orchestration and structured memory traversal rather than gradient-coupled retriever training.

papers.title: Walking Down the Memory Maze: Beyond Context Limit through Interactive Reading
papers.one_liner: MemWalker builds a query-agnostic hierarchical memory tree of summaries and interactively navigates it with CoT prompts to answer beyond context limits.
papers.summary: Текущая работа предлагает интересное альтернативное решение под названием MemWalker. Метод работает в два этапа.

clusters.name: Differentiable Retrieval RAG
clusters.distinguishing: Jointly learns retrieval and generation with continuous memory tokens and straight-through top-k relaxation for end-to-end optimization. Unlike hierarchical memory approaches, this cluster integrates retrieval into the computation graph; unlike embedding-focused clusters, it optimizes utility-driven document selection rather than standalone vector quality.

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Differentiable Retrieval via Continuous Latent Reasoning
papers.one_liner: CLaRa makes RAG differentiable by learning retrieval and generation jointly via continuous memory tokens and STE-based top-k, improving utility-driven document selection.
papers.summary: Представили CLaRa — унифицированный фреймворк для RAG, который сжимает документы в непрерывные "токены памяти" (memory tokens) и оптимизирует поиск и генерацию end-to-end. Используя технику Straight-Through Estimator (STE), авторы пробрасывают градиенты от функции потерь языковой модели обратно в механизм поиска. Это заставляет ретривер выбирать документы не просто по семантической близости, а по их реальной полезности для генерации ответа.

families.name: Math & formal reasoning models
families.curated_description: LLMs for math and formal proofs: AlphaProof, AlphaGeometry, Lean / Coq-coupled provers, math-specialised pretraining.
families.distinguishing: This family focuses on models that generate or verify mathematically rigorous arguments, often producing machine-checkable proofs in systems like Lean or Coq, or coupling LLMs with symbolic deduction engines for domains such as Euclidean geometry. Unlike general reasoning or agent papers, these works optimize for formal correctness under proof assistant semantics, use search/planning over proof states, and evaluate by proof verification rather than heuristic metrics. They frequently leverage math-specialized pretraining corpora, theorem-prover interaction datasets, and AlphaZero-style guidance to synthesize full proof scripts, distinguishing them from informal CoT reasoning, generic VLM/omni models, or broad RL. The binding property is end-to-end formal rigor: the output must pass a proof checker or a domain-specific symbolic verifier.

clusters.name: Neuro-Symbolic Geometry
clusters.distinguishing: Focuses on Euclidean geometry with a dedicated symbolic deduction engine coupled to an LLM. Distinct from general formal proof systems by exploiting geometry-specific constraints and constructions rather than generic proof assistants or broad mathematical domains.

papers.title: https://deepmind.google/discover/blog/alphageometry-an-olympiad-level-ai-system-for-geometry/
papers.one_liner: Neuro-symbolic system combining an LLM with a geometry deduction engine to generate Olympiad-level Euclidean proofs.
papers.summary: Результат между серебряной и золотой медалями на одимпиадных геометрических задачах.

clusters.name: LLM Formal Proving with Search
clusters.distinguishing: Uses formal proof assistants (Lean) and combines LLM guidance with AlphaZero-style or similar search to synthesize machine-checkable proofs. Unlike neuro-symbolic geometry, it is domain-general within formal math; unlike informal LLM proof generation, it targets fully verified proofs within a proof assistant.

papers.title: https://deepmind.google/discover/blog/ai-solves-imo-problems-at-silver-medal-level/
papers.one_liner: Combines LLM-to-Lean translation with AlphaZero-style proof search to solve IMO problems at silver-medal level.
papers.summary: AlphaGeometry 2 обучена на гораздо большем объеме задач, чем её предшественница и имеет на два порядка более быстрый символьный движок.

clusters.name: Coq-Verified Math Results
clusters.distinguishing: Centers on a specific, fully formalized mathematical result proved in Coq via exhaustive enumeration and pruning (Busy Beaver). Differs from LLM-driven formal provers by relying on classical formal verification workflows and exhaustive analysis rather than learned guidance.

papers.title: https://www.quantamagazine.org/amateur-mathematicians-find-fifth-busy-beaver-turing-machine-20240702/
papers.one_liner: Formal Coq-verified proof establishing BB(5)=47,176,870 via exhaustive analysis of 5-state Turing machines.
papers.summary: Сегодня доказали (используя Coq), что пятое число Busy Beaver, BB(5), равно 47,176,870

clusters.name: Informal LLM Proof Synthesis
clusters.distinguishing: Evaluates an LLM’s capacity to produce novel mathematical arguments without end-to-end integration with a proof assistant. Unlike the formal clusters, validation is human-driven and not mechanically checked; unlike geometry, it spans general optimization theory rather than a specific subdomain with a symbolic engine.

papers.title: Claim: gpt-5-pro can prove new interesting mathematics.
papers.one_liner: Evaluates GPT-5-Pro’s ability to generate correct novel proofs improving bounds in convex optimization.
papers.summary: Proof: I took a convex optimization paper with a clean open problem in it and asked gpt-5-pro to work on it. It proved a better bound than what is in the paper, and I checked the proof it's correct.

families.name: Systems
families.distinguishing: Papers in Systems focus on the end-to-end machinery that makes large-scale AI training and inference feasible: hardware architectures, memory hierarchies, interconnects, scheduling, and datacenter-scale efficiency. They analyze or design concrete accelerators, co-design stacks, and cost/energy models that quantify throughput, latency, and $/token, rather than proposing new model objectives or datasets. Unlike optimization or scaling-law work, these papers change the compute substrate and deployment pipeline (e.g., compute-in-memory, 3D integration, KV/activation pipelines, power/cooling), often with measured or modeled system-level speedups and energy savings. The unifying thread is delivering practical, cross-layer performance/efficiency gains for training and serving, not algorithmic capabilities.

clusters.name: Thermodynamic Analog Accelerators
clusters.distinguishing: Focuses on a specific non-von-Neumann hardware architecture that exploits stochastic, thermodynamic dynamics for AI primitives. Distinct from planning or economics, it provides concrete continuous-time, analog mechanisms (Gaussian sampling and matrix inversion) with scaling and energy claims versus GPUs.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Computing System for AI Applications
papers.one_liner: Introduces a continuous-variable thermodynamic SPU that accelerates Gaussian sampling and matrix inversion with stochastic analog dynamics, showing O(d^2) scaling and energy advantages over GPUs.
papers.summary: Немалое число алгоритмов в ML основано на различной физике, например, energy-based модели или диффузия. Стохастика вообще используется везде, от инициализации весов, через строительные блоки нейросетей (dropout), до процедур генерации (та же диффузия или более старые VAE и GANы). Для таких алгоритмов природные стохастические флуктуации могут стать важным ресурсом.

clusters.name: AI–Hardware Co-Design Roadmaps
clusters.distinguishing: Sets a strategic, cross-stack vision for achieving large energy-efficiency gains via compute-in-memory, 3D integration, and AI-driven EDA across cloud-to-edge. Unlike a single device proposal, it synthesizes system-level directions and integration pathways rather than detailing one concrete accelerator or cost model.

papers.title: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
papers.one_liner: A 10-year AI–hardware co-design roadmap targeting 1000× end-to-end energy efficiency via compute-in-memory, 3D integration, and AI-driven EDA across cloud-to-edge.
papers.summary: Масштабный консорциум лидеров индустрии и академии составил комплексную 10-летнюю дорожную карту для объединения разработки ИИ-алгоритмов и железа. Цель — улучшить эффективность обучения и инференса в 1000 раз.

clusters.name: Frontier Training Cost Economics
clusters.distinguishing: Analyzes the economic composition and scaling of frontier model training costs, separating hardware, energy, and R&D components with forward projections. Unlike hardware design or roadmapping, it is a quantitative cost model for end-to-end training expenditures and trajectories.

papers.title: "Our analysis reveals that the amortized hardware and energy cost for the final training run of frontier models has grown rapidly, at a rate of 2.4x per year since 2016 (95% CI: 2.0x to 3.1x). We also estimated a cost breakdown to develop key frontier models such as GPT-4 and Gemini Ultra, including R&D staff costs and compute for experiments. We found that most of the development cost is for the hardware at 47–67%, but R&D staff costs are substantial at 29–49%, with the remaining 2–6% going to energy consumption.
papers.one_liner: Economic analysis quantifying hardware, energy, and R&D staff shares in frontier model training costs, projecting billion-dollar runs by 2027.

families.name: Other:Slide Notes Generation
families.distinguishing: Papers in this family focus on automatically producing presenter notes or slide outlines from existing slide decks or source documents, typically framing the task as structured summarization aligned to slide layout, section hierarchy, and speaking cadence. They distinguish themselves by modeling slide-specific constraints—per-slide bulleting, time-aware note length, and visual-text anchoring—rather than general long-form summarization, RAG, or multimodal captioning. Unlike VLMs or omni-multimodal models, the output is not free-form description but delivery-ready notes synchronized to slides and transitions, often optimizing for coherence across a deck and avoiding redundancy. This is application-oriented generation, separate from core LLM pretraining, RLHF post-training, or reasoning-time methods.

clusters.name: other:slide-notes-generation
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: Generating speaker notes for a set of slides. Nice!
papers.one_liner: Automatically generate speaker notes from slide decks to assist presentation preparation.

families.name: Other:Quantum Computing Hardware
families.distinguishing: This family focuses on physical quantum computing devices and architectures—qubits (superconducting, trapped-ion, photonic), control electronics, cryogenics, error rates, and coherence—detailing how hardware design and noise processes shape computational capability. Unlike ML model papers, these works measure gate fidelities, crosstalk, and error-correction thresholds, propose new qubit layouts or materials, and report experimental benchmarks from lab setups. The unifying trait is hardware-level advances and characterization for scalable quantum processors, not algorithms, training paradigms, or AI system design.
